dialogues.jp: 「……珍しい組み合わせだな」
dialogues.en: "...Now that's an unusual pairing."
dialogues.text: "...Now that's an unusual pairing."

dialogues.jp:
体育館裏を通りかかると、ちょうど環と工藤が
二人で話していた。
dialogues.en: Tamaki and Kudou were talking, behind the school gym.
dialogues.text: Tamaki and Kudou were talking, behind the school gym.

dialogues.jp: 学園の美男子と和風美人の環……。
dialogues.en:
The school's number one pretty boy, and the traditional
beauty Tamaki...
dialogues.text:
The school's number one pretty boy, and the traditional
beauty Tamaki...

dialogues.jp: なかなか絵になる取り合わせじゃないか。
dialogues.en: They actually look pretty good together.
dialogues.text: They actually look pretty good together.

dialogues.jp: 何を話してるんだ？　妙に真剣な様子だが……。
dialogues.en:
I wonder what they're talking about? They seem pretty
serious...
dialogues.text:
I wonder what they're talking about? They seem pretty
serious...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura..."

dialogues.jp: 工藤が俺に気づいた。
dialogues.en: Kudou noticed me in the shadows.
dialogues.text: Kudou noticed me in the shadows.

dialogues.jp: 「やあ、キミ達。こんなところでおそろいで」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you two. Sorry for the rudeness."
dialogues.text: "Hey, you two. Sorry for the rudeness."

dialogues.jp:
別に覗く気はなかったんだけれど、気づかれた
なら仕方がない。
dialogues.en:
I wasn't meaning to eavesdrop, but the circumstances
certainly didn't look good anyway.
dialogues.text:
I wasn't meaning to eavesdrop, but the circumstances
certainly didn't look good anyway.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ハハハと笑いながら、妙なテンションで
登場する。
dialogues.en:
I tried to laugh off the tension, as I made myself more
visible to the two of them.
dialogues.text:
I tried to laugh off the tension, as I made myself more
visible to the two of them.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「もしかして、邪魔しちゃった？　告白シーン
　だったとか」
dialogues.en: "Am I interrupting something? Like a confession, perhaps?"
dialogues.text: "Am I interrupting something? Like a confession, perhaps?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「いや、そうじゃなくて」
dialogues.en: "N, no, not at all."
dialogues.text: "N, no, not at all."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「しかし、お前が環に、ねぇ……」
dialogues.en: "Really? You and Tamaki though, hmm..."
dialogues.text: "Really? You and Tamaki though, hmm..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、わざとニヤニヤしながら、工藤を見る。
dialogues.en: I mockingly rubbed my chin and smirked at Kudou.
dialogues.text: I mockingly rubbed my chin and smirked at Kudou.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「違うよ。朝倉。オレは胡ノ宮さんの相談に乗っ
　ていて……」
dialogues.en:
"You've got it wrong, Asakura. I was just asking
Konomiya-san about something..."
dialogues.text:
"You've got it wrong, Asakura. I was just asking
Konomiya-san about something..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「まあまあ、隠すコトじゃないだろ？　仲良き
　ことは美しきかなってさ」
dialogues.en:
"Now now, it's not something you need to hide! It's good to
be close, after all!"
dialogues.text:
"Now now, it's not something you need to hide! It's good to
be close, after all!"

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、わかっててからかう。工藤だって、
その辺をわかってるはずだ。
dialogues.en:
Of course, I knew. Kudou probably guessed that I was just
acting, as well.
dialogues.text:
Of course, I knew. Kudou probably guessed that I was just
acting, as well.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、ほんとに告白シーンだったら、俺はただ
のバカだが。
dialogues.en:
If it really was a confession scene though, I'd be the real
idiot.
dialogues.text:
If it really was a confession scene though, I'd be the real
idiot.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そんなんじゃありません！」
dialogues.en: "That's not it at all!"
dialogues.text: "That's not it at all!"

dialogues.jp:
声の方を見ると、今まで黙っていた環が、真剣
に怒っている。
dialogues.en:
My eyes instinctively moved to the sound of the passionate
voice. The previously silent Tamaki had spoken.
dialogues.text:
My eyes instinctively moved to the sound of the passionate
voice. The previously silent Tamaki had spoken.

dialogues.jp: 俺は一瞬、その雰囲気に飲まれる。
dialogues.en:
It took me a second to digest the sudden change in
atmosphere.
dialogues.text:
It took me a second to digest the sudden change in
atmosphere.

dialogues.jp:
普段は穏やかな環が、珍しく感情的になってい
る。
dialogues.en:
It was rare to see the usually calm Tamaki, so emotional
about somehting.
dialogues.text:
It was rare to see the usually calm Tamaki, so emotional
about somehting.

dialogues.jp: 見ると、工藤も驚いたらしい。
dialogues.en: Even Kudou was shocked.
dialogues.text: Even Kudou was shocked.

dialogues.jp: 言葉を失っている。
dialogues.en: Silence reigned throughout the area.
dialogues.text: Silence reigned throughout the area.

dialogues.jp: 環は俺を真剣な表情で見つめている。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki was still staring at me, the seriousness on her face
plain to see.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki was still staring at me, the seriousness on her face
plain to see.

dialogues.jp: 冗談じゃ済まない雰囲気だった。
dialogues.en:
It was an atmosphere that indicated that all jokes had to be
stopped.
dialogues.text:
It was an atmosphere that indicated that all jokes had to be
stopped.

dialogues.jp: 「な、なんでそんなにムキになるんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Y, you don't need to react that much..."
dialogues.text: "Y, you don't need to react that much..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、ほら……ただの冗談じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, you know... it was just a joke."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, you know... it was just a joke."

dialogues.jp: 工藤も『うん』と頷く。
dialogues.en: Kudou nodded in agreement.
dialogues.text: Kudou nodded in agreement.

dialogues.jp:
もっとも、あまり趣味がよいとは言えないのは、
認めるけれど。
dialogues.en:
He may not have directly acknowledged it, but he certanily
recognized it...
dialogues.text:
He may not have directly acknowledged it, but he certanily
recognized it...

dialogues.jp: ハッと環が気づいたような表情になる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was genuinely taken aback at my "revelation".
dialogues.text: Tamaki was genuinely taken aback at my "revelation".

dialogues.en: "Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わたくしとしたことが……。なんだか、力が
　入ってしまって……どうしたんだろう……」
dialogues.en:
"W, why did I... why did I act so strongly... what should
I...?"
dialogues.text:
"W, why did I... why did I act so strongly... what should
I...?"

dialogues.jp: 環は、急にしおらしくなる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's words were garbled and rushed.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's words were garbled and rushed.

dialogues.jp: 一体、何なんだ？
dialogues.en: What's with her?
dialogues.text: What's with her?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなさい。大きな声を出してしまって
　……工藤様も、すいません」
dialogues.en:
"I'm very sorry, for speaking so loudly... to you as well,
Kudou-sama."
dialogues.text:
"I'm very sorry, for speaking so loudly... to you as well,
Kudou-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、オレは別にいいよ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, it's fine with me."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, it's fine with me."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「いや、まあ……変な冗談を言ったのは、俺の
　方だし、俺の方こそ、すまん」
dialogues.en:
"No, well... I was making a stupid joke as well, so I'm
sorry too."
dialogues.text:
"No, well... I was making a stupid joke as well, so I'm
sorry too."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ふ、雰囲気が暗くなってしまいましたね。私、
　教室に帰ります」
dialogues.en: "Hm, the air's gotten darker... I shall head back to class."
dialogues.text: "Hm, the air's gotten darker... I shall head back to class."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ」
dialogues.en: "Goodbye."
dialogues.text: "Goodbye."

dialogues.jp: 環は逃げるように教室へ帰っていってしまった。
dialogues.en: Running away successfully, Tamaki left for the classroom.
dialogues.text: Running away successfully, Tamaki left for the classroom.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっとやりすぎたかな」
dialogues.en: "I guess I went a bit too far."
dialogues.text: "I guess I went a bit too far."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「さあ。乙女心は複雑だからね」
dialogues.en: "Perhaps. A young woman's heart is complex."
dialogues.text: "Perhaps. A young woman's heart is complex."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「難しいな……」
dialogues.en: "How annoying..."
dialogues.text: "How annoying..."

dialogues.jp: ◆ムキになる環◆
dialogues.en: ◆Direct Tamaki?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Direct Tamaki?◆

dialogues.jp:
昼休み、体育館裏へ行くと、環と工藤が何やら
深刻そうに話をしている。
dialogues.en:
During lunch, I went to the back of the gym, and found Kudou
and Tamaki engrossed in a serious conversation.
dialogues.text:
During lunch, I went to the back of the gym, and found Kudou
and Tamaki engrossed in a serious conversation.

dialogues.jp:
二人のことを冷やかすと、真剣な表情で環が怒っ
てしまった。
dialogues.en:
I teased them about the relationship, which Tamaki got
seirously angry about.
dialogues.text:
I teased them about the relationship, which Tamaki got
seirously angry about.

dialogues.jp: 俺、何かまずいこと言ったのだろうか？
dialogues.en: Did I say something that bad?
dialogues.text: Did I say something that bad?
